generation.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: History Go historical object illustration, a square museum-style editorial image. Primary request: original hand-painted and ink illustration representing the documented Halvorsens Conditori business delivery vehicle photographed outside Prinsens gate 26, Oslo, approximately 1925, Oslo Museum record OB.Z06453 (photographer credited Herson). Source supports that a confectionery firm vehicle existed there; the exact make, registration, colours and surviving status are NOT established. Depict only an unbranded early-1920s small enclosed delivery van, three-quarter side view, all wheels and entire silhouette visible, grounded in a subtle drawn shadow. Clearly handmade, expressive ink contours, restrained charcoal and warm grey wash, rich paper texture and carefully observed period proportions; not a photograph, not photorealistic, not glossy 3D or flat vector clipart. Simple pale neutral background, no street or architecture, no people. This is an interpretive representation of the documented vehicle type, NOT a precise reconstruction. Do not invent a car marque, grille badge, registration plate characters, bakery sign or any logo. Leave vehicle side panel blank. No invented historical colour claim: use monochrome illustration. Along the lower edge include a clean, highly legible caption, exactly: “Illustrasjon – ikke fotografi”. Below it in smaller clean type: “Biltype illustrert – detaljene er ikke dokumentert”. Keep the caption inside a generous safe margin. Balanced composition with vehicle filling about 75% width, comfortable breathing space, ready for an educational object card.

review.visual: Original PNG and final WebP both visually inspected; clearly illustrated, complete vehicle silhouette, legible disclosure, no legible brand or registration text.
